    Homogeneous ideals generated by path-category relations #

    If the specified relation generators in a free linear path category are homogeneous for path length, then the two-sided linear Hom ideal that they generate is homogeneous. Arbitrary multipliers are expanded in the path bases on the two sides.

    Two-sided composites of a relation generator with path-basis morphisms on both sides.
